notes: Horizontal HR/risk workflow product - government is one of roughly fifteen industries listed alongside manufacturing, retail, and hospitality. description: School nutrition software for menu planning, production, inventory, point of sale, and eligibility at K-12 districts and state agencies
notes: Candidate listed as "SchoolCafe + PrimeroEdge" - both are brands of Cybersoft Technologies, Inc. (founded 1998, Houston); SchoolCafe is the parent-facing menu, application, and payment portal. Canonical product/brand name is PrimeroEdge.

description: Capital planning, program, and construction management software for transportation departments, cities, counties, and water utilities
notes: Candidate had no URL; aurigo.com confirmed. Masterworks spans all capital programs (transportation, water, facilities) and they also sell to private infrastructure owners such as datacenters and life sciences - category picked as Streets because state DOTs and county public works are the flagship market, but Fleet & Asset Mgmt is a defensible alternative.

description: Cloud legal practice management, billing, and document software for law firms
notes: Exhibited at the municipal attorneys' conference, but the stated target market is solo practitioners and small-to-midsize private law firms - government legal departments are a slice, not the primary buyer. Real product company, so flagging for the owner rather than calling it govtech. Legal entity Themis Solutions Inc.; clio.com returns 403 to both WebFetch and curl, so details come from Clio's own blog/about pages via search.

description: Closed-loop referral and care coordination software for community care hubs, area agencies on aging, and community-based organizations
notes: Legal entity is Cumulus Care Inc. (confirmed in a license string embedded in the site). No HQ or founding year published on the site, including the team and contact pages, so both omitted. Buyers are a mix of public agencies (AAAs, state and regional networks) and nonprofit CBOs.

description: AI report writing and field supervision assistant for probation, parole, and pretrial agencies
notes: HQ and founding year come from a third-party company database, not the company site (cognisen.com/about returns 404 and no address appears in the footer) - worth confirming. Listed partner of the Chief Probation Officers of California.

description: AI assistant that drafts case notes, builds case plans, and schedules field visits for community supervision agencies
notes: Operated by String Inc. per its terms of service; the site is a short demo-request page with no address, team, or founding date, so hq_location and year_founded omitted. Distinct from the unrelated casebase.ai portfolio-management product. Listed on the Chief Probation Officers of California site, which corroborates the exhibitor.

description: Customer information and billing software for municipal, cooperative, and investor-owned electric, water, and gas utilities
notes: Candidate had no URL; advancedutility.com confirmed (product is CIS Infinity). A division of N. Harris Computer Corporation. Founding year 1997 is from company boilerplate carried in third-party listings, not the current site. Note the sector map has no billing/CIS category under Utilities & Energy - Grid & Energy is the closest fit and I used it for all four utility-billing vendors in this batch.
